comparison.objective: Clamp a glued panel joint closed with three alternating clamps.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp placement, controlled jaw force, joint alignment, and alternating above/below configuration.
comparison.success_condition: Joint ≤0.2 mm open, boards level, three clamps snug at 1–6 N in the alternating pattern, hands clear and still for 1 s; over-force zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed force application and panel alignment, not loose-body separation.
